name: Customer and brand owner exchange direct messages
description: Verify the customer-to-brand enquiry, product context, owner reply and persisted cross-actor conversation.
steps: Actor A signs in as a customer and opens a published product
Actor A chooses Message Brand and sends the prefilled size/availability inquiry
Actor B signs in as the owner of that brand, opens Messages and replies
Actor A reopens the same conversation and verifies the reply remains visible after refresh
expected: Only the customer and linked brand owner can see the conversation; the brand owner can reply and both actors see the exchanged messages in the same thread.

name: Brand submits a Journal story for admin approval
description: Verify brand owners can draft and submit editorial stories with an image, and only approved stories appear in the public Journal.
steps: Actor A signs in as a brand owner and opens Journal & Editorial in the brand dashboard
Actor A creates a story with title, intro, body, category and an image, then saves it as a draft
Actor A edits the draft and submits it for review
Actor B signs in as Vaa admin and opens editorial review
Actor B publishes Actor A's pending story
Open the public Journal and verify the approved story appears and its related-piece action opens relevant products
expected: The story persists in the brand workspace, remains private while draft or pending, and appears publicly only after admin publication.

name: Brand subscription request and admin approval
description: Verify an eligible brand owner can submit a payment reference and an admin can approve the pending subscription.
steps: Actor A signs in as a brand owner whose trial or subscription has expired
Actor A submits a valid M-Pesa reference and verifies the request is pending review
Actor B signs in as the Vaa admin
Actor B opens subscription reviews and approves Actor A's pending request
Actor A refreshes the brand dashboard and verifies the subscription is active
expected: The payment reference is saved for review, admin approval activates the brand subscription for 30 days, and the updated status is visible to the brand owner.

name: Customer checkout and payment are disabled
description: Verify customers are directed to message brands rather than using a cart or customer checkout.
steps: Browse products and open a product detail panel
Verify the primary action is Message Brand and no cart or checkout control is shown
Attempt the legacy order API if available
expected: No cart, checkout or customer payment option is available; customers can message brands and legacy order creation returns a deprecation error.

name: Mobile account dropdown opens sign-in and sign-up
description: Verify a mobile visitor can open the account dropdown and reach the authentication dialog.
covers: customer and brand registration role choice
steps: Open Vaa at a mobile viewport while signed out
Tap the account icon in the navbar
Verify the dropdown stays inside the viewport and offers Sign in and Sign up
Choose Sign up and select Brand
Verify optional verification evidence does not require a BRS certificate or government ID
Switch to Sign in and verify the dialog remains usable
expected: The mobile dropdown stays inside the viewport and both registration and sign-in remain usable.
